job.label: Sawn-off — Fine
job.prompt:
Create the Fine-finish cosmetic variant of the attached fictional RPG sawn-off double-barrel shotgun inventory painting for Project Heaven Cry. This is a 2D digital game-art asset. FIRST attachment fixes the exact visible Standard geometry and registration: preserve its complete outline, all parts and openings, proportions, pose, camera, scale and margins. SECOND attachment supplies Heavenprint ink and gouache brushwork only, never a person or scene.

Grade: Fine. The same gun, refinished. An even, unscratched finish on the slide or receiver, its edges and the muzzle crown bright; the grip panels or stock clean; moving parts look freshly oiled. Add one thin engraved line along the side of the slide or receiver, following its top edge. Nothing else is added.

Same compact stockless up-right pose; TWO short side-by-side dark steel barrels with dark bores, TWO exposed curved hammers, original small brass side fitting with THREE ochre diagonal daubs, rounded guard and original trigger, short downward grip with its red-brown cloth wrap and riveted heel. Keep all barrel/hammers/guard spacing and exact wrap routes. No shoulder stock or barrel extension. The one new uncoloured line follows the upper side of the existing small frame; preserve all original red cloth and ochre daubs. Apply those surface changes only to the actual object shown. No new coloured inlay, ornament or repair at Fine. Do not add, remove, resize or move a part or opening. Hand-painted opaque gouache and ink, broken directional strokes and selective dry-brush, charcoal shadows, warm ivory focal edges, upper-left light. Full transparent background,1024x1024RGBA, same framing and at least50px clear margin. No cast shadow, ground, scene, figure, hand, text, letters, numbers, logos, labels, frame, border, flash, smoke or external glow. Exterior painted illustration only, no technical diagram, internal mechanism, measurements, assembly steps or operating instructions.
job.keep_line: the same stockless cut-down double-barrel shotgun pointing up-right with two short side-by-side dark steel barrels and dark muzzle bores, two exposed curved hammers, small brass side fitting with three ochre diagonal daubs, rounded trigger guard and short downward-curved dark grip wrapped in red-brown cloth with a riveted metal heel plate. Preserve all barrel spacing, hammer shapes, bore openings, pivot screws, daub positions, grip wrap routes and compact proportions. Do not add a shoulder stock or extend the barrels.
